title: Liam O NDE 6674
content: When I was twelve, I was on holiday with my thirteen year old friend Darren and his parents. Darren and I were playing with our overturned dinghy, [small, utilitarian boat] jumping on top and swimming underneath to the air pocket. I was under the dinghy and breathing in the air pocket when Darren jumped on top of the dinghy. I was sucked to the bottom in the vacuum created and in my panic, immediately started swallowing water. I kicked and thrashed around until my body gave up. It felt like I was drifting off somewhere and I remember an incredibly calm, euphoric feeling coming over me. Then my whole life. Every single second, flashed before my eyes at what seemed like light-speed, but I still was able to comprehend everything. Not just every event, but every interaction I'd ever had. I saw how my words and actions had affected the recipients and what they had thought of me, good or bad. After that, I started drifting off into this dark void and my euphoria turned to abject terror as my mind turned to thoughts of annihilation, drifting into this darkness, as if I thought the lights were going to go out for me permanently. At this point Darren was grabbing me by the hair and pulling me out of water and on to the top of the overturned dinghy. It felt like I was rushing back into my body at the same time as I was being pulled out of the water. I then spent several minutes coughing up water, relaying my story to a skeptical Darren.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Near-drowning under an overturned dinghy; swallowed water and lost physical capacity.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Initial calm/euphoria while drowning, followed by drifting into a dark void and terror of annihilation; then rushing back into the body as rescued.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Euphoria/calm preceded an extensive life review; then a dark void; then abrupt return during physical rescue.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Return felt simultaneous with being pulled out of the water: "rushing back into my body at the same time as I was being pulled out of the water."

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Fear centered on annihilation while drifting into darkness ("as if I thought the lights were going to go out for me permanently").
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "Every single second, flashed before my eyes at what seemed like light-speed, but I still was able to comprehend everything."
